description: This Java class 'Animation3' is an Android activity demonstrating the use of different interpolators with animations. It sets up a spinner to choose an interpolator and applies it to a translation animation on a target view.

classes.name: Animation3
classes.description: Android activity demonstrating animated interpolators on a view.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures spinner for selecting interpolators.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of an interpolator; applies the chosen interpolator to a translation animation.

methods.name: onNothingSelected
methods.description: Does nothing when no spinner item is selected.
